# Test fixtures

`fw_golden_vectors_cbec2da.json` - three REQUEST datagrams copied unchanged from the firmware
repository `noctinirs-2`, file `test/communication/golden_vectors.json`, at commit
`cbec2dab8e23595ae4e374e181c0d7c70f25edec`. They are the only firmware-derived byte vectors
used; everything else in `test_control.py` is self-made and says so. No device data.
